Snapdragon Jokes

Roll d8

Roll Joke
1 What is a dragon’s favorite instrument? The horns.
2 Why are dragons such good musicians? Because they know their scales.
3 What is a dragon’s favorite snack? Firecrackers.
4 Why are dragons boring storytellers? They have such long tales.
5 Why don’t dragons come up with plans? They prefer to wing it.
6 What does a knight and a piece of bread have in common? A little firebreath and they're both toast.
7 What do you say to an angry dragon? No need to get fired up.
8 Why are dragons such bad hiking partners? Because they're always drag'n behind.
